sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This policy establishes public and internal redress paths for persons affected by AI-influenced decisions made by {org_name} within {boundary}, operationalizing the redress and accountability dimension of Texas SB 1964. Aligned to the statute; not legal advice.

sections.heading: 2. Redress and Complaint Paths

questions.prompt: How does an affected person request review or file a complaint about an AI-influenced decision (intake channel)?
Who reviews redress requests and what is the target response time?
What is the escalation path, including the route to meaningful human review of the decision?

sections.body: A person affected by an AI-influenced decision may seek review or file a complaint via {redress_intake}. Requests are reviewed by {redress_review}. Each request routes to {redress_escalation}, ensuring a path to meaningful human review of the contested decision. Redress requests and their resolutions are logged.
